requirement_text: Control flow of the four FCPs shall be similar, if not identical.
requirement_text_raw: Control flow of the four FCPs shall (3.3.11.2) be similar, if not identical.
rationale: "Similar, if not identical" is not measurable.
clarification_questions: How similar must the control flow of the four FCPs be?
Which differences between the FCPs are allowed?

requirement_text: Job Seeker registration shall allow the addition of CV as a Word file to the CV database.
user_story: As a job seeker, I want to add my CV as a Word file to the CV database when I register, so that employers can find it.
technical_task: Let job seeker registration accept a CV as a Word file and add it to the CV database.
acceptance_criteria: Given the registration form, when the job seeker attaches a CV as a Word file, then it is added to the CV database.
Given a CV in another file format, when the job seeker attaches it, then it is not accepted as a Word file.
rationale: Role stated: job seeker. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: E.g. a shorter button press of 90 milliseconds during the 100 milliseconds cycle is also transferred, for example.
rationale: The sentence is an example fragment ("E.g.") and refers to a requirement that is not included.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or an example for another requirement?
What must be transferred when a button is pressed for a shorter time than the cycle?

requirement_text: The LHCP is then provided counts for the specified time period as well as a bar chart.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want counts for the specified time period and a bar chart, so that I can see the trend.
technical_task: Show the LHCP counts for the specified time period together with a bar chart.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specified time period, when the LHCP requests it, then the counts for that period are shown.
Given the counts, when they are displayed, then a bar chart is shown with them.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The counts are not named in the requirement.

requirement_text: System shall ensure that prescriptions are mapped to one and only one chemist or lab based on the patient's pincode.
user_story: As a patient, I want each prescription assigned to one chemist or lab based on my pincode, so that I know where to go.
technical_task: Map every prescription to exactly one chemist or lab chosen by the patient's pincode.
acceptance_criteria: Given a prescription and the patient's pincode, when it is mapped, then it is assigned to a chemist or lab.
Given a mapped prescription, when its assignment is checked, then it is mapped to one and only one chemist or lab.

requirement_text: The system shall provide selection menus to minimize the need for manual typing of options.
user_story: As a user, I want selection menus for options, so that I type less.
technical_task: Provide selection menus for options to cut down on manual typing.
acceptance_criteria: Given an option field, when the user opens it, then a selection menu is offered.
Given a selection menu, when the user picks an entry, then no typing is needed to set the option.

requirement_text: While synchronization is being attempted, the FCP virtual group shall maintain synchronous operations.
requirement_text_raw: While synchronization is being attempted, the FCP virtual group shall [SRS123] maintain synchronous operations.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCP virtual group to keep running synchronously while synchronization is being attempted, so that operation is not interrupted.
technical_task: Maintain synchronous operations of the FCP virtual group during synchronization attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a synchronization attempt is in progress, when the FCP virtual group runs, then its operations remain synchronous.
Given a synchronization attempt ends, when the FCP virtual group runs, then it stays synchronous.

requirement_text: User shall/will interact with an intuitive user interface requiring minimal training.
clarification_questions: How is "intuitive" tested, for example by task completion?

requirement_text: The website shall support screen reader software for disabled users and comply with 508 standards.
user_story: As a user with a disability, I want the website to work with screen reader software and meet 508 standards, so that I can use it.
technical_task: Support screen reader software on the website and comply with 508 standards.
acceptance_criteria: Given screen reader software, when a disabled user opens the website, then its content can be read.
Given the 508 standards, when the website is checked against them, then it complies.
rationale: Role assumed: user with a disability.

requirement_text: The system should perform its intended function without failure for a specified period.
rationale: "A specified period" and "intended function" are not given.
clarification_questions: For how long must the system run without failure?
What counts as a failure and as the intended function?

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to segment contacts based on various criteria for targeted communication.
user_story: As a marketer, I want to segment contacts by different criteria, so that I can send targeted messages.
technical_task: Provide contact segmentation based on selectable criteria for targeted communication.
acceptance_criteria: Given contacts, when the user applies a criterion, then the matching contacts form a segment.
Given a segment, when the user sends a message, then it goes only to the contacts in the segment.
rationale: Role assumed: marketer. The criteria are not listed.

requirement_text: System shall terminate user sessions upon logout, destroying the session and redirecting to the home page.
user_story: As a user, I want my session ended at logout and to land on the home page, so that nobody can reuse it.
technical_task: End the session at logout by destroying it and redirect to the home page.
acceptance_criteria: Given a logged-in user, when the user logs out, then the session is destroyed.
Given the session has been destroyed, when the logout completes, then the user is redirected to the home page.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to display the web-portal in Swedish upon administrator selection.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to display the web portal in Swedish, so that Swedish readers can use it.
technical_task: Offer Swedish as a display language of the web portal, chosen by the administrator.
acceptance_criteria: Given the administrator selects Swedish, when the web portal is displayed, then it is shown in Swedish.
Given Swedish has not been selected, when the portal is displayed, then it is not shown in Swedish.

requirement_text: The system shall be intuitive to the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.
requirement_text_raw: The system shall be intuitive to the Program Administrators/Nursing Staff Members.'
rationale: "Intuitive" is subjective and has no test.
clarification_questions: How is the system judged "intuitive" for Program Administrators and Nursing Staff Members?
Which tasks and success rate are used to check it?

requirement_text: The system shall respond to highest priority user input or external interrupt and resume previous state upon completion.
user_story: As a system operator, I want the system to react to the highest priority input or interrupt and go back to its earlier state afterwards, so that urgent events are handled first.
technical_task: Respond to the highest priority user input or external interrupt and resume the previous state when it is done.
acceptance_criteria: Given several user inputs or interrupts, when they arrive, then the highest priority one is handled first.
Given the handling is complete, when the system continues, then it resumes its previous state.

requirement_text: Each row in the list includes their blood pressure and glucose levels recording timestamp and whom reported the data (patient UAP name personal representative name).
requirement_text_raw: Each row in the list includes their blood pressure and glucose levels  recording timestamp  and whom reported the data (patient  UAP name  personal representative name).
user_story: As a clinician, I want each list row to show the blood pressure and glucose recording time and who reported it, so that I can judge the data.
technical_task: Include in each list row the recording timestamp of the blood pressure and glucose levels and the name of the reporter, being the patient, the UAP or the personal representative.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of recorded readings, when it is displayed, then each row has the recording timestamp.
Given a row, when it is displayed, then it shows who reported the data, either the patient, the UAP or the personal representative.

requirement_text: On the patient homepage the Patient views a notification center.
requirement_text_raw: On the patient homepage  the Patient views a notification center.
user_story: As a patient, I want a notification center on my homepage, so that I can see my notifications.
technical_task: Show a notification center on the patient homepage.
acceptance_criteria: Given the patient homepage, when it is displayed, then it contains a notification center.
Given a new notification, when the patient opens the notification center, then the notification is listed.
rationale: Role stated: patient. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: System shall allow dataset developers to assign explicit versions to the code of a dataset type.
user_story: As a dataset developer, I want to assign explicit versions to the code of a dataset type, so that I can track changes.
technical_task: Provide versioning for the code of a dataset type with explicit version assignment.
acceptance_criteria: Given the code of a dataset type, when the developer assigns a version, then the version is stored with the code.
Given a versioned dataset type, when it is viewed, then its explicit version is shown.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to insert speaker notes for slides.
user_story: As a presenter, I want to insert speaker notes for slides, so that I remember what to say.
technical_task: Support adding speaker notes to each slide.
acceptance_criteria: Given a slide, when the user types speaker notes, then they are saved with the slide.
Given a slide with speaker notes, when it is opened, then the notes are shown.

requirement_text: You can see that the claim has been "Marked as cleared.
requirement_text_raw: You can see that the claim has been "Marked as cleared."
rationale: The sentence describes what the reader sees and is cut off by a quotation mark.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a description of a screen message?
What must the system do when a claim is marked as cleared?

requirement_text: Audit logs should be retained as long as clinical records.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want audit logs kept as long as clinical records, so that audits remain possible.
technical_task: Retain audit logs for the same period as the clinical records.
acceptance_criteria: Given a clinical record, when its retention period runs, then the related audit logs are kept for the same time.
Given an audit log, when its retention period is checked, then it is not shorter than that of the clinical records.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. The retention period itself is not given.

requirement_text: This policy stipulates that no cell (e.g. admittances discharges patients services) 10 or less may be displayed.
requirement_text_raw: This policy stipulates that no cell (e.g. admittances  discharges  patients  services) 10 or less may be displayed.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want cells with 10 or fewer counts not displayed, so that individuals cannot be identified.
technical_task: Suppress the display of any cell, for example admittances, discharges, patients or services, with a count of 10 or less.
acceptance_criteria: Given a cell with a count of 10 or less, when the report is displayed, then the cell is not shown.
Given a cell with a count above 10, when the report is displayed, then the cell is shown.

requirement_text: Only users with Update access must be able to initiate dispute requests.
requirement_text_raw: Only users with Update access must be able to initiate dispute requests.'
user_story: As a user with Update access, I want to start dispute requests, so that only authorized users can start them.
technical_task: Allow only users with Update access to initiate dispute requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with Update access, when the user starts a dispute request, then it is initiated.
Given a user without Update access, when the user tries to start a dispute request, then it is refused.
rationale: Role stated: user with Update access.

requirement_text: Usernames and passwords shall not be shared with anyone (students, faculty, or others).
user_story: As a security officer, I want usernames and passwords never shared, so that accounts stay personal.
technical_task: Prohibit sharing of usernames and passwords with anyone, including students and faculty.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user's username and password, when the account is used, then they are not shared with another person.
Given students, faculty or others, when they use the system, then each uses their own credentials.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. How sharing is detected is not stated.

requirement_text: FABS user shall successfully submit a citywide as a PPoPZIP and pass validations for comprehensive data submission.
user_story: As a FABS user, I want to submit a citywide as a PPoPZIP and pass validations, so that my data submission is complete.
technical_task: Accept a citywide value as a PPoPZIP in a submission and run the validations needed for a comprehensive data submission.
acceptance_criteria: Given a citywide entered as a PPoPZIP, when the FABS user submits, then the submission is accepted.
Given the submission, when the validations run, then it passes them.
rationale: Role stated: FABS user. The validation rules are not listed.

requirement_text: Verify that a person or entity seeking access to electronic health information is the one claimed and is authorized to access such information.
user_story: As a security officer, I want to verify that anyone seeking access to electronic health information is who they claim and is authorized, so that only the right people read it.
technical_task: Verify the identity and the authorization of a person or entity before access to electronic health information is granted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a person or entity seeking access, when access is requested, then the claimed identity is verified.
Given a verified person or entity, when access is requested, then authorization is checked before access is granted.

requirement_text: Administrator shall be able to add new books to the library based on user requests, inputting all relevant details.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to add books requested by users and enter all relevant details, so that the library stays up to date.
technical_task: Provide a form for administrators to add a new book to the library with all relevant details.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user request for a book, when the administrator enters the details and saves, then the book is added to the library.
Given an added book, when it is viewed, then its details are shown.

requirement_text: Only a moderator shall be able to group ideas and specify a name for the group.
user_story: As a moderator, I want to group ideas and name the group, so that related ideas are together.
technical_task: Allow only a moderator to group ideas and give each group a name.
acceptance_criteria: Given several ideas, when the moderator groups them and names the group, then the group is saved with that name.
Given a user who is not a moderator, when the user tries to group ideas, then it is refused.

requirement_text: User shall be able to manage Digital Objects.
user_story: As a user, I want to manage Digital Objects, so that I can keep them organized.
technical_task: Provide management functions for Digital Objects.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Digital Object, when the user edits it and saves, then the change is stored.
Given a Digital Object, when the user deletes it, then it is removed.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The management actions are an interpretation.

requirement_text: Official events listed on Drexel website, location and hours will have accuracy greater than 40%.
user_story: As a visitor, I want official events, locations and hours shown with accuracy above 40%, so that I can rely on them.
technical_task: Display official events listed on the Drexel website, with their location and hours, at an accuracy of more than 40%.
acceptance_criteria: Given the official events on the Drexel website, when their accuracy is measured, then it is greater than 40%.
Given an accuracy of 40% or less, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: User shall have their meal planner tailored to accommodate their allergies and food choices for safety and dietary preferences.
user_story: As a user with allergies, I want my meal planner adapted to my allergies and food choices, so that meals are safe and match my preferences.
technical_task: Tailor the meal planner to the user's allergies and food choices.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user with entered allergies, when the meal planner proposes meals, then it excludes them.
Given a user with food choices, when the meal planner proposes meals, then it matches those choices.

requirement_text: System shall validate email and phone numbers during signup to ensure uniqueness.
user_story: As a new user, I want my email and phone number validated at signup for uniqueness, so that duplicate accounts are avoided.
technical_task: Validate that the email and phone number are unique during signup.
acceptance_criteria: Given an email or phone number not yet registered, when the user signs up, then signup continues.
Given an email or phone number already registered, when the user signs up, then it is rejected.

requirement_text: The details of transitions shall be disclossed to OEM.
user_story: As an OEM representative, I want the details of transitions disclosed to me, so that I can see how states change.
technical_task: Disclose the details of the transitions to the OEM.
acceptance_criteria: Given the transition details, when they are prepared, then they are disclosed to the OEM.
Given the OEM, when it asks for transition details, then they are available.
rationale: Role assumed: OEM representative. Which transitions are meant is not stated.

requirement_text: All content on Crafty kids corner shall be age-appropriate and suitable for children.
user_story: As a parent, I want all content on Crafty kids corner to be age-appropriate, so that it is suitable for my child.
technical_task: Ensure that all content on Crafty kids corner is age-appropriate and suitable for children.
acceptance_criteria: Given content on Crafty kids corner, when it is published, then it is age-appropriate.
Given content that is not suitable for children, when it is found, then it is not shown.
rationale: Role assumed: parent. The age range is not given.

requirement_text: Alternatively, the user can push the delete key of the keyboard to delete the connection.
user_story: As a user, I want to press the delete key to delete a connection, so that I can remove it quickly.
technical_task: Support deleting a connection with the delete key of the keyboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given a selected connection, when the user presses the delete key, then the connection is deleted.
Given no selected connection, when the user presses the delete key, then nothing is deleted.
rationale: Role assumed: user. This is an alternative to another way of deleting a connection.

requirement_text: The customer shall receive notifications upon both order acceptance and order delivery.
user_story: As a customer, I want notifications when my order is accepted and when it is delivered, so that I know its progress.
technical_task: Send notifications to the customer on order acceptance and on order delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Given an order is accepted, when the acceptance occurs, then the customer receives a notification.
Given an order is delivered, when the delivery occurs, then the customer receives a notification.

requirement_text: The details of this block are described in the sub chapter below "ECU Specific Environmental Data" [DI-109].
rationale: The sentence only points to another section.
clarification_questions: What does the sub chapter "ECU Specific Environmental Data" contain?
Is the referenced chapter part of this requirement?

requirement_text: Sensitive data and secrets are not incorporated in code.
requirement_text_raw: Sensitive data and secrets are not incorporated in  code.
user_story: As a security officer, I want sensitive data and secrets kept out of code, so that they are not leaked.
technical_task: Keep sensitive data and secrets out of the source code.
acceptance_criteria: Given the source code, when it is reviewed, then it contains no sensitive data or secrets.
Given a secret the application needs, when it is supplied, then it is provided outside the code.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: Dr Susan Poslusny and Dr Julie Donalek are the only people who shall have access to students' personal information.
requirement_text_raw: Dr Susan Poslusny and Dr Julie Donalek are the only people who shall have access to students' personal information.'
user_story: As a program coordinator, I want only Dr Susan Poslusny and Dr Julie Donalek to see students' personal information, so that privacy is protected.
technical_task: Restrict access to students' personal information to Dr Susan Poslusny and Dr Julie Donalek.
acceptance_criteria: Given Dr Susan Poslusny or Dr Julie Donalek, when either opens students' personal information, then access is granted.
Given any other person, when the person tries to open students' personal information, then access is denied.

requirement_text: A server shall host the RMOS and provide system data processing and storage capability.
requirement_text_raw: A server shall host the RMOS and provide system data processing and storage  capability.
user_story: As a system operator, I want a server to host the RMOS and provide data processing and storage, so that the system has a home.
technical_task: Run the RMOS on a server that offers data processing and storage capability for system data.
acceptance_criteria: Given the RMOS, when it is deployed, then it is hosted on a server.
Given system data, when it is processed or stored, then the server provides the capability.

requirement_text: System shall automatically populate relevant DMP fields with existing institutional data.
user_story: As a researcher, I want relevant DMP fields filled automatically from existing institutional data, so that I enter less by hand.
technical_task: Prefill relevant Data Management Plan fields from existing institutional data.
acceptance_criteria: Given existing institutional data, when a DMP is created, then relevant fields are filled automatically.
Given a field with no institutional data, when the DMP is created, then the field is left for the user to enter.

requirement_text: If a user leaves the game prematurely, a new CO is created on another user's machine to fill their place.
user_story: As a player, I want a new CO created on another user's machine when someone leaves early, so that the game goes on.
technical_task: Create a new CO on another user's machine to take the place of a user who leaves the game prematurely.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user leaves the game prematurely, when the departure is detected, then a new CO is created on another user's machine.
Given the new CO, when the game continues, then it fills the place of the user who left.

requirement_text: The system shall allow camp administrators to send warnings to staff members.
user_story: As a camp administrator, I want to send warnings to staff members, so that problems are flagged.
technical_task: Provide a function for camp administrators to send warnings to staff members.
acceptance_criteria: Given a staff member, when the camp administrator sends a warning, then the staff member receives it.
Given a sent warning, when the administrator reviews it, then it is recorded as sent.

requirement_text: Employees shall be able to maintain daily logs.
user_story: As an employee, I want to keep daily logs, so that my work is recorded.
technical_task: Allow employees to maintain a log for each day.
acceptance_criteria: Given a day, when an employee enters a log entry, then it is saved.
Given a saved log, when the employee opens it, then the entries are shown.

requirement_text: Each syndrome shall represent an occurrence of the indicated error at some time between delivery of the previous packet and delivery of the current packet.
requirement_text_raw: Each syndrome shall (3.2.2.6.4) represent an occurrence of the indicated error at some time between delivery of the previous packet and delivery of the current packet.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want each syndrome to mean an occurrence of the indicated error between the previous and current packet deliveries, so that errors are placed in time.
technical_task: Define each syndrome as an occurrence of the indicated error at some time between delivery of the previous packet and delivery of the current packet.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs between the delivery of two packets, when the syndrome is read, then it indicates that occurrence.
Given no error occurs between the two deliveries, when the syndrome is read, then it does not indicate the error.

requirement_text: User shall choose to download the article.
user_story: As a reader, I want to choose to download an article, so that I can read it offline.
technical_task: Offer a download option for articles.
acceptance_criteria: Given an article, when the user chooses to download it, then it is downloaded.
Given an article, when the user does not choose to download, then no file is downloaded.

requirement_text: The Development Team shall label every scheduled [SYSTEM NAME] build in the source control system.
rationale: The requirement contains the placeholder [SYSTEM NAME].
clarification_questions: Which system does [SYSTEM NAME] stand for?
What is a "scheduled build" and what label format applies?

requirement_text: Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.
requirement_text_raw: Aside from server failure  the software product shall achieve 99.99\% up time.'
user_story: As a user, I want the software available 99.99% of the time apart from server failure, so that I can rely on it.
technical_task: Achieve 99.99% up time of the software product, excluding server failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a measurement period, when up time is computed without server failure, then it is at least 99.99%.
Given up time below 99.99% not caused by server failure, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: In all FCP IBIT cases, provided the hardware state permits, the FTSS shall log the error and report it in the X-38 telemetry stream.
requirement_text_raw: In all FCP IBIT cases, provided the hardware state permits, the FTSS shall (3.3.2.29) log the error and report it in the X-38 telemetry stream.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS to log and report each FCP IBIT error in the X-38 telemetry stream when the hardware state permits, so that faults are visible.
technical_task: Log the error in all FCP IBIT cases and report it in the X-38 telemetry stream, provided the hardware state permits.
acceptance_criteria: Given an FCP IBIT error and a hardware state that permits it, when it occurs, then the FTSS logs the error.
Given the same error and hardware state, when it occurs, then the FTSS reports it in the X-38 telemetry stream.

requirement_text: The system shall provide a structured experience for users to navigate through commands tailored to their needs.
rationale: "Structured experience" and "tailored to their needs" are not measurable.
clarification_questions: What commands and user needs must the structured experience cover?
